messages:
incident-bot: Pager — canary-service: high 5xx rate on canary slice (alert INC-2026-235)
incident-bot: metric: canary-3 error-rate 4.8% → paging on-call
amanda: acked, jumping in
luis: oncall here, looking at svc logs and recent deploys
amanda: spike started ~2026-03-17T01:12Z right after the release of featureflag 'suppressor'
devon: that flag rollout touched tokenizer preprocessor path — i'm checking the rollout window
luis: quick log grep shows tokenizer mismatches + downstream 502s from grpc gateway
sasha: any customer reports? support-ops, pinged?
support-ops: 6 customers opened incidents, mostly timeouts and 502s, started ~01:13Z
amanda: plan: flip FF kill-switch now. If errors persist, revert the single commit that introduced the suppressor change
devon: prepared revert commit 4a1b9e7 (PR ready) — can apply hotpatch to canary once flag flip confirmed
deploy-bot: Feature flag update requested by devon: suppressor -> OFF
deploy-bot: Feature flag suppressor set to OFF (target: canary slice)
luis: error-rate dropped from 4.8% → 1.6% after FF flip, still above baseline 0.02%
amanda: ok attempt 2: apply small fastpatch to canary (revert commit). devon please apply
devon: applying revert to canary now: kubectl -n canary set image deploy/canary-service something@sha:4a1b9e7-revert
deploy-bot: rolling update started for deploy/canary-service in namespace canary
luis: pods terminating and recreating, watching logs
# log snippet from canary pod 12: \n# 2026-03-17T01:18:16Z ERROR tokenizer: unexpected token length mismatch (input=512, expected<=256)
amanda: that log matches the hypothesis — commit altered tokenization bounds; feature flag gating didn't fully protect path
devon: hotpatch applied to canary; verifying health checks
deploy-bot: rollout complete for canary, 3/3 pods ready (revision: revert-4a1b9e7)
luis: error-rate now down to 0.03% on canary; good signal
sasha: customer impact summary: 6 customers affected, intermittent 502s/timeouts, approx 12m of degraded UX before mitigation; CS alerted and sent initial message
amanda: recommend slow rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10–15m watch windows. Also create incident page and postmortem items
devon: will open the PR merge to main and trigger staged rollout after we pass canary 30m
amanda: i'm handing off monitoring to luis for next 2h. i'm stepping out at 03:30Z
luis: taking over monitoring. I'll watch latency/error SLOs and be available on the incident thread
incident-bot: Incident severity reduced to S2 — mitigation in place
support-ops: affected customers follow-ups queued; will send final update once full rollout completes
sasha: follow-ups assigned: add automated FF kill-switch test, add regression test for tokenizer bounds, and update runbook for similar deploy patterns
amanda: thanks everyone — great fast coordination :thumbsup: 
incident-bot: incident closed (mitigation successful). Postmortem requested (owner: sasha).
